summary.text: Peter Lumaj, a Republican Fairfield real estate investor and former immigration legal adviser, lost the November 3, 2026 election for Secretary of the State of Connecticut to Stephanie Thomas.
He has sought statewide office repeatedly, including two bids for U.S. Senate and a run for governor.

paragraphs.text: Lumaj was born in Albania. He worked as an immigration legal adviser and is now a real estate investor in Fairfield.
Lumaj has run unsuccessfully for statewide office four times: twice for U.S. Senate, once for governor and once for Secretary of the State.
His only appearance on a November ballot before this year was as the Republican secretary nominee in 2014.
He received 36.5% of the vote to Stephanie Thomas's 63.5%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
